secrets.name: CODE_STATS_TOKEN
secrets.how: Fine-grained token code-stats-<date>, resource owner workbench-soft, All repositories, 1 year, Repository permissions Contents read-only. Metadata read-only comes with it.
secrets.revoke: Delete the older code-stats token on https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens.
secrets.cost: pages.yml reads it to count the private repos for the Engineering section, and lumiere-desktop-mac.yml checks out lumiere-player with it. Without it the site hides the code numbers and the Lumiere Mac build fails.
